newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends firmer in post-holiday doldrums.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends firmer in post-holiday doldrums.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished firmer on Friday but below the day's high in light post-holiday trade.
At the close, the Taiwan dollar was quoted at T$27.486 to the U.S. unit against Wednesday's T$27.493 finish. The market was closed on Thursday for National Day.
Volume traded through brokers was a sleepy US$148 million.
After a quiet morning, the Taiwan dollar blipped to T$27.483 in the afternoon on a handful of trades but failed to cling to that level.

"The market was thin and a couple of small trades could move prices," said one dealer, adding that he was unimpressed with the late burst of buying. "People have given up testing support and resistance levels in this market."
The U.S. dollar's own rangebound trade against major currencies in Asian trading thickened the torpor in Taiwan currency's market, the dealer said.
